from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyHousingRecord(BaseModel):
    """A specific month's housing construction statistics extracted from a single report."""
    month: str | None = Field(description="The calendar month the data refers to, in YYYY-MM format")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="The date this specific report was issued, to determine precedence when values conflict")
    report_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the report source")
    starts_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Total Housing Starts")
    completions_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Total Housing Completions")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_records: list[MonthlyHousingRecord]
